name: set_complement
description: Compute the relative complement of a listed set in a finite universe; matched control copies the given set in the same notation.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[]; control=[]
for i in range(120):
 n=random.randint(4,9); universe=list(range(1,n+1)); a=sorted(random.sample(universe,random.randint(1,n-1))); b=[x for x in universe if x not in a]
 fmt=lambda xs:'{'+', '.join(map(str,xs))+'}'
 context=f'Universe U = {fmt(universe)}. Set A = {fmt(a)}. '
 items.append({'prompt':context+'Give the complement of A in U, listing elements in increasing order. Answer:','answer':' '+fmt(b)})
 control.append({'prompt':context+'Give the elements of A, listing elements in increasing order. Answer:','answer':' '+fmt(a)})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
